The sound cut records dialogue and mixes the recorded tracks. A separate picture cut edits the images. What can the sound cut hand out next?

Verb levels (concept: dependency graph; reads)
Purpose: Show the levels of the cut’s work packages, computed from which must return before which, so the packages of one level can be built side by side, each with where it stands; refused while packages depend on each other in a cycle, naming them
When: To see the order and the parallel work the packages allow, before any builder is set to work or after changing their dependencies

Verb state (concept: ledger; reads)
Purpose: Tell where the cut stands, from its ledger (the cut’s history of what its agents were given and returned): its branch, contexts and the architect holding each; its phase; each work package’s status, approved only once two independent assayers (agents who judge the work against its examples) both pass it; the packages ready for their builder, never started or returned to build by a finding or a failing whole check; and the last report its lead (the agent running the cut) returned
When: Before acting on a cut, and whenever its progress matters: each answer is worked out afresh, so an earlier answer never stands for the current state
State is the published readiness operation. I will query sound and keep the separate picture cut distinct.

Sound can hand out nothing next: its ready list is empty. Recording is in flight and mix depends on its return. Picture has editing ready, but that belongs to picture, not sound; an empty sound list is a valid answer.

report: Sound can hand out nothing next: its ready list is empty. Recording is in flight and mix depends on its return. Picture has editing ready, but that belongs to picture, not sound; an empty sound list is a valid answer.
